First Saturday Art Market at Degallery

Saturday, November 7, 2026
11:00 AM – 4:00 PM

  • Admission: Free
Website

Join DeGallery for November's First Saturday Art Market. This event showcases art and artisans as well as local artists from VAS. Make sure to stop inside Degallery to see some amazing artwork including our VAS member show! The show will leave October 27th so don’t miss it. There will also be crafts and live music.

This is a family friendly event open to the public with arts, crafts and live music. For interested vendors, this is a tremendous opportunity to sell your work in the area. VAS Members can sign up for a booth space for free so membership is definitely recommended! Please see the VAS website for further details.
